LanguageData.WFL_Tr_PayrollHelp: Wages are paid on the 1st and 8th of every quadrum from the treasury, for finished work by people assigned to a profession. If the money is short everyone receives the same share and the rest stays owed. Payroll never creates silver.

LanguageData.WFL_Tr_OrdinaryCap: Most ordinary labour can earn one person in a day
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_TaxLocked: Taxation is locked. Assign a qualified Tax Collector (Professions page) to unlock it. Until then the community may keep a share of income, but that is not a tax.
